english:
Every 100 years, the mysterious castle of Sudokuvania appears in the countryside. Legend has it that it contains the Secret of Sudoku. Gathering the last few given digits in the area, you solemnly approach the boxy fortress, determined to discover the secret and share it with your favorite people.
---

Note for SudokuPad: Sudokuvania is best played in a desktop browser.
For the best experience, open the Settings menu and ensure the following settings are enabled:
Experimental > Test Large Puzzle UI: ON
Visual > Draw Arrows Above Lines: ON
Visual > Disable Emoji Replacement: ON

Rules:
Gattai Sudoku - In each square grid, enter digits from 1-N into each row, column, and region, where N is the length of each side of the grid.
Dynamic Fog - The map is covered with fog. Placing correct digits may reveal more clues or rules.
Clues may only be used if their associated rule is uncovered in the Learned Rules panel (in the upper left).
Dynamic Rules - Selecting cells can change the rules displayed in this panel (scroll down to see them); to avoid spoilers, try not to read the rules when a cell covered by fog is selected.
* Select a cell in the map to learn more about its grid, and to get a link to its Boss Puzzle (if applicable).
* Select a rule in the Learned Rules panel for more details.

视觉效果 > 将箭头绘制在线条上方：开启
视觉效果 > 禁用表情符号替换：开启

规则：
拼接数独——每个正方形网格的边长为 N；在每行、每列及每个区域中填入 1 至 N，且不得重复。

动态规则——选中不同格子会改变此面板中显示的规则（可向下滚动）。为了避免剧透，尽量不要阅读仍被迷雾遮住的格子所显示的规则。
* 选中地图上的格子，可了解其所属网格，并查看相关首领谜题的链接（如有）。
* 在「已学会的规则」面板中选中某条规则，可以阅读完整说明。

english:
The castle of Sudokuvania shimmers in the morning air and dissipates with the last of the remaining fog. A short distance away, you trudge up a small hill towards the waiting figure of the Guru. Somehow, you aren’t surprised to see her here.
“The world will never know how you saved Sudoku from those cultists,” she says. “Was it worth it? Did you find what you were looking for?”
You think about the adventures you’ve had and the friends you made along the way, and nod. You may not have found the Secret of Sudoku, but you did gain insight you’ll keep all your life. That, and a sack of gold.
“One more thing,” the Guru calls as you depart. (You wish she would stop doing that.) “Did you remember to turn off the lights before you left?”
Oh, bobbins.

"Nooooooo! It's not fair!" The imp's pleading voice is pitiful, but it can't hide a deceitful tone. Who knows how long this creature has been guiding the course of Sudoku from its seat of power here? You can't allow it to continue.
With the last of the 7x7 grid filled, you stand at the doorway looking down on the defeated monster. Knowing the rest of the castle has also been filled with digits, you take hold of the lines throughout this 7x7 grid and pull sharply; the walls and ceiling instantly collapse onto the once-ruler, caving in the heart of Sudokuvania.

You wearily make your way towards the entryway, and the town outside. What was it all for? You'd never even found a hint of what happened to your father all those years ago. And what will happen to Sudoku if there is no king?

You suddenly become aware of the castle's power, a thrumming heat that had always been there, just behind your conscious mind. You had the sense that... it *wanted* you to stay. It was about to leave this plane of existence, and it needed a ruler. After all, someone had to be in charge of Sudoku--to set the rules and dictate the flows of logic for the puzzling world to solve. And you had proved yourself tonight, hadn't you?

Ann Givens and her father meet you at the front gate of Sudokuvania. They see you smile as you approach, and their own smiles fade as you swing the gate shut between you. Then the castle itself shimmers and vanishes, and they never see you again.

Congratulations! You have conquered Sudokuvania and become the ruler of Sudoku.

Developed by Skeptical Mario

SudokuPad by Sven Neumann

Created with SudokuMaker by sirxemic

Ever since he disappeared in a Sudoku attack, you have had questions about your father's fate. Now that the mythical castle Sudokuvania has reappeared, you know the answers must lie somewhere within.
---

[version 1.1.1]
Rules:
Complete the Quests by filling each grid according to its rules. Completely filling all grids is NOT required to reach an ending of the story.
Sudoku - Unless overridden by an uncovered rule, you may assume that each grid follows normal sudoku rules: Place digits from 1-n into each grid, where n is the grid's square size, without repeating in a row, column, or box.
Dynamic Fog - Entering a correct digit into a cell will clear the fog from that cell and perhaps others.
Dynamic Rules - Additional rules will be displayed in this panel when certain cells are selected. Abridged rules are also displayed on the map itself. These rules are only valid if the selected cell is NOT covered by fog. Some cells outside the grid are uncovered by default because they have no associated rules; drag at these 'pan handles' to avoid spoilers.
Select the ⚙️ to read about settings.
Select the 📋 to read about play controls.

[Click here](https://sudokupad.app/sudokuvania/lineage-of-logic-plain?setting-nogrid=1&setting-largepuzzle=1) to play the plain version of this puzzle.

Blink cells teleport you to a 'destination cell' indexed by the blink cell's row or column in its grid.

A blink cell contains either horizontal or vertical bars, and two short arrows; the arrows point at the nearest cell containing the value N in any orthogonal direction, where N is the blink cell's row number in the current grid if there are blue horizontal bars, or the blink cell's column number if there are red vertical bars.
There will always be one nearest cell, meaning no ties, and the blink cell itself cannot contain N. However, the destination cell may lie in a different grid than the clue.

Quest Lines

Quest Lines indicate your primary goals in the game and can lead you towards your objectives. Each Quest Line follows its own unique rules; which are learned when the quest is given (though you may see the line before then). The line's rules are displayed in shorthand on the Journal, and in full in the Rules Panel when those Journal cells are selected.

For each Quest, there is exactly one associated line, which can move orthogonally or diagonally, but which cannot branch or cross itself.
Quest lines must remain inside the grids of the map.

The following SudokuPad settings may improve performance and readability:
 * Experimental → Test Large Puzzle UI: Turn ON to enable zooming and panning.
 * Tools → Enable Pen Tool, Enable Letter Tool: Please turn ON (these tools will come in handy).
 * Visual → Outlines on Digits, Outlines on Arrows/Lines: When turned ON, these settings may improve digit readability but decrease performance.
 * Visual → Disable Emoji Replacement: When turned ON, some icons will be rendered with transparency to improve readability; however, some icons may not display correctly in all browsers.
 * Gameplay → Show Seen Cells, Conflict Checker: When turned ON, these settings indicate where conflicts can occur before and after entering digits, respectively. Note that any fog remaining in the row, column, or region will prevent these features from working as expected.
 * Advanced → Killer Calculator, Calculate Cell Sums: Please turn OFF to improve performance!

以下设置有助于提高原版 SudokuPad 的性能和可读性：
 * 实验性功能 → 测试大型谜题界面：开启，以支持缩放与移动；本 Android 版还提供下方触屏控制栏。
 * 工具 → 启用画线工具、字母工具：建议开启；游戏进程中会用到。本 Android 版也能通过下方按钮启用。
 * 视觉效果 → 数字描边、箭头与线条描边：开启后更清晰，但可能降低运行速度。
 * 视觉效果 → 禁用表情替换：开启后部分图标会以透明背景显示，阅读更方便；个别图标也可能出现异常。
 * 游戏玩法 → 显示可见格、冲突检查：开启后，分别提示填数前后可能发生冲突的位置。如果同一行、列或区域内仍有迷雾，提示可能不完整。
 * 高级设置 → 杀手数独计算器、计算格子总和：建议关闭，以改善性能。
